context: Where compute savings live. Parquet internals (row groups, column chunks, encodings, column stats, predicate pushdown), codecs ratio-vs-speed, partitioning and pruning, the small-file problem and compaction (echo LSM merging from IR 101), object storage semantics (immutability, consistency limits), and open table formats (Iceberg/Delta): ACID via metadata layers, snapshots/time travel, schema evolution rules, safe backfills, and atomic rebuild-and-swap as an INTRO (the operational playbook lives in DE 401). Reactivate the postings-compression bridge from IR 101.
